text:
kevin: quick RFC follow-up — I'm worried about ambiguous semantics when we apply delta-encoded policy patches at runtime. Proposal: (1) deltas are additive-only (no in-place edits), (2) each delta carries an 'intent' tag (canary | promote | rollback | compaction), (3) runtime exposes ApplyDelta(delta_id, base_version) and rejects on base mismatch. Also thinking we do pointer-swap commit for zero-downtime switch. Concerns: size growth, per-tenant overrides, and observable versioning. Thoughts?
jessie: sgtm in spirit. additive-only is simpler but we need a plan for compaction snapshots or we'll accumulate megabytes of deltas over months.
anya: compaction + snapshot makes sense. question: per-tenant overrides — store as tenant-layer deltas or keep tenant overrides in a separate namespaced blob?
miguel: prefer tenant-layer deltas, but enforce guardrails: max lookback window and eviction TTL. runtime should support precompute/merge cache for tenants with overrides so lookups are fast.
sam: ops angle — during apply we'll have a brief window where some replicas have new policy and others don't. we need a commit barrier or two-phase commit. pointer-swap on the runtime instance is safer: build merged policy off-thread, then atomically swap pointer. if anything fails, fallback to old pointer.
kevin: exactly. pointer-swap + versioning lets us cheaply rollback. runtime contract idea: ApplyDelta returns (new_version, applied_replicas, commit_ok). if applied_replicas < quorum -> runtime auto-aborts and emits rollback event.
ops-bot: alert: policy-apply job failed on region-eu-2: base_version mismatch for patch id=2024-06-xx-07. investigate.
jessie: for observability we must tag routing traces with policy_version and delta_id so evals can correlate regressions to a specific patch. without that, rollbacks will be a blind guess.
anya: small API change then: add policy_version header to request context and include delta metadata in the tracing span. low-risk.
miguel: perf note — stream deltas to avoid OOMs in sidecars. pseudocode:
```
ApplyDelta(stream delta_chunks) -> new_version
  buffer <- stream_chunks
  validate(buffer)
  merge_off_thread(buffer)
  pointer_swap(new_version)
```
Streaming keeps memory bounded.
sam: one more subtlety — model-variant scoring order must be deterministic across replicas to avoid flapping. add deterministic sort key in the merge process derived from (policy_id, tenant_id, delta_seq).
kevin: nice catch. action items: 1) update RFC to include delta schema, intent tags, and compaction plan (jessie), 2) runtime API spec for ApplyDelta + pointer-swap + stream apply + compaction (anya + miguel), 3) add policy_version header + tracing tags and make rollout/rollback alerts (sam). I'll open follow-up PRs for each.
jessie: :thumbsup: I'll also sketch compaction cron defaults (monthly snapshot + immediate compaction after major migration).
kevin: thanks all — if nobody objects I'll fold this into the RFC and schedule a deep-dive next Wed.
